body.description: a traveler from the river side, a thin woman in her thirties: a dusty grey wrap over her head and shoulders, a faded red scarf, a bedroll tied on her back, worn boots, wary tired face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
